objective: GATE 3F-G IDEMPOTENCY MIGRATION PREFLIGHT. Validar exclusivamente, sin DDL ni writes, que el diseño minimo propuesto es compatible con el esquema actual: (A) unique filtered index de una sola queue activa por DecisionPagoID; (B) agregar en el futuro Finanzas_Pagos.PagoOrigenQueueID BIGINT NULL como correlacion generica, con FK a Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue(PagoOrigenQueueID) y unique filtered index WHERE PagoOrigenQueueID IS NOT NULL; (C) no duplicar DecisionPagoID ni HashOrigen en Finanzas_Pagos porque se derivan canonicamente desde queue; (D) preservar compatibilidad con COA_ExpedienteReferencias que referencia PagoID. Certificar o bloquear este diseño antes de escribir una migracion.

queries.name: f3g_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: f3g_active_queue_duplicates_by_decision
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT DecisionPagoID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue WHERE Activo=1 GROUP BY DecisionPagoID HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3g_queue_pk
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i INNER JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') AND i.is_primary_key=1 ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: f3g_pagos_rows
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Finanzas_Pagos

queries.name: f3g_pagos_incoming_fks
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_table,fk.name AS fk_name FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') ORDER BY child_schema,child_table,fk.name

queries.name: f3g_queue_outgoing_fk_target
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') ORDER BY fk.name

queries.name: f3g_pagos_column_name_collision
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') AND c.name IN (N'PagoOrigenQueueID',N'DecisionPagoID',N'HashOrigen',N'IdempotencyKey') ORDER BY c.name

queries.name: f3g_queue_index_name_collision
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name FROM sys.indexes i WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') AND i.name IN (N'UQ_Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue_Decision_Activo')

queries.name: f3g_pagos_index_name_collision
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name FROM sys.indexes i WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') AND i.name IN (N'UQ_Finanzas_Pagos_PagoOrigenQueueID')

queries.name: f3g_queue_incoming_fks
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_table,fk.name AS fk_name FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') ORDER BY child_schema,child_table,fk.name
